title: gaultheria cinnamomifolia
intro: Gaultheria cinnamomifolia, commonly known as the cinnamon-berry or mountain pepper, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Gaultheria cinnamomifolia include its analgesic and anti-arthritic effects, which may provide relief from pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, such as eugenol and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
